Cave Run Lake: Kentucky Predator Fishing

Make freshwater predators the focus at Cave Run Lake. Spend a Kentucky fishing day with time to work the water cast by cast.

About this water

The fishery source record for Cave Run Lake, United States, identifies Largemouth bass, Muskellunge, White bass and Spotted bass.

At Cave Run Lake, decide whether the main objective is muskellunge or a bass outing before buying tackle. Ask the guide to specify the useful lure weights, rod compatibility and landing tools for that choice. Confirm what the boat supplies and where it departs. The source record does not make a specialist setup necessary for every visitor. Keep any alternative fish program explicit instead of combining incompatible equipment recommendations.

LICENCE & PERMITS

Fishing licence for Kentucky

Anglers aged 16 or older generally need a fishing licence. The Cumberland River trout-permit rule also covers anglers who release all their fish.

  • 1 day$15.86 USD
  • 7 days$37 USD
  • March 1 through the last day of February$58.14 USD
